svg.title: FlyBot on AWS: architecture
svg.text: Input → OpenCV 5 → Vision/Perception layer → AI/Agent layer → AWS infrastructure → Decision/Action; a confirmed action produces the next photo
MQTT to IoT Core, KVS master,
lure tray floor or sticky card
none in this entry: tools are

Columns 2-4 run inside one Lambda invocation per photo. Numbers: models/MODEL_CARD.md, bench/REPORT_COOL.md, infra/template.yaml.
